suggestion.topic: Python AsyncIO vs Threading: When to Stop Blocking Your Loop
suggestion.rationale: Developers continually struggle with choosing concurrency models in Python, frequently mixing up I/O bound tasks with CPU bound bottlenecks. Capitalizing on high search volume around asyncio vs threading will drive strong completion rates.
suggestion.hook_angle: Stop using threading for high-concurrency web scrapers until you see how this single event loop mistake crashes your entire Python app.
